intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Indianapolis for 2026, and here is what he found: 35 family events, 10 of them free. The magic runs from November 26 (Christmas Nights of Lights at the Indiana State Fairgrounds) through January 2 (Festival of Trees at the Indiana History Center), with Circle of Lights, Jingle Rails, Christmas at the Zoo, the Broad Ripple Lights Up Festival and Parade (December 6) and Grinchmas at Riverside Park (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Indianapolis

  • 35 Christmas events for kids in Indianapolis
  • 10 free events, including the Broad Ripple Lights Up Festival and Parade and Grinchmas at Riverside Park
  • Meet Santa: Skate with Santa at Holliday Park, Yuletide Celebration Brunch with Santa at Hilbert Circle Theatre and Breakfast with Santa at the OrthoIndy Foundation YMCA
  • Lights and shows: Christmas Nights of Lights, Conservatory Crossing at Garfield Park, A Christmas Carol at Beef and Boards and The Nutcracker at Clowes Memorial Hall
  • Season: November 26, 2026 to January 2, 2027 for the events added here
